messages:
maria: quick check — onboarding ACME in the dev environment, their sample payloads include customer emails. can we set dev logs TTL to 7d and enable on-write redaction? who needs to approve?

devon: we can do 7d lifecycle, but redaction must run before we persist. dev uses the redwood-dev-logs bucket for dev traffic, so ingestion lambda needs to scrub emails/phones. also we should restrict bucket read ACLs.

priya: policy note: dev envs shouldn't retain identifiable customer PII longer than 30d without explicit approval. for short onboarding windows 7d is fine if logs are redacted and access is limited. we'll need the data owner sign-off + a security reviewer for the lambda change.

maria: who is the data owner for ACME?

jonah: that's me for the POC. i can sign off for the onboarding window. prefer 7d + redaction + scoped access.

devon: created a quick config diff i can push once we have sign-off. example lifecycle + lockdown commands below so folks know what i'll apply:

```bash
# restrict bucket policy
aws s3api put-bucket-policy --bucket redwood-dev-logs \\  --policy file://dev-logs-lockdown.json

# apply lifecycle for prefix
aws s3api put-bucket-lifecycle-configuration --bucket redwood-dev-logs --lifecycle-configuration file://acme-lifecycle.json
```

acme-lifecycle.json: 
```json
{"Rules":[{"Prefix":"acme/","Status":"Enabled","Expiration":{"Days":7}}]}
```

devon: i'll also add a bucket policy that only allows principals in the dev team + an automated redact lambda role.

priya: reqs for my approval: 1) ingestion lambda removes emails and phone numbers before S3 PUT, 2) minimal ACLs on bucket (no wide dev group read), 3) we add an audit tag on logs for this onboarding. if all true i can approve. i'll do a quick review of the lambda in ~2 hours.

maria: i'll open the PR with the lambda change + lifecycle JSON and tag you both. jonah, you'll be the data owner sign-off?

jonah: yep, i'll add a comment in the PR approving the 7d retention for the onboarding window. please include a note that we will revisit after POC (target: remove data or extend retention with business case).

sec-bot: Audit ticket created: SEC-2026 — dev bucket exception (ACME onboarding). assigned to priya & devon for review.

maria: thanks all. will wait on priya review before applying. :thumbsup:

priya: noted — will ping here once i've done the lambda pass.
